pares.citacao: sec.3.3.1.1 p.6-7: 'The concrete structural system was designed based on The Egyptian Code for Design and Executing Reinforced Concrete Structures' ... 'Reinforced concrete grade in the project is with cubic characteristics strength of 25 N/mm2'
pares.nota: VIA NORMA CITADA: codigo egipcio (ECP 203) citado no mesmo paragrafo da classe; nao escreve '28 d'. O texto nao imprime a sigla ECP 203 nem idade. A ACV (Tally) usa o material NRMCA 'Structural concrete, 3001-4000 psi' (Tab.3), nao o 25 N/mm2. Se a Kie preferir exigir a idade escrita, passar a null/classe_sem_idade.

notas: Classe de projecto cubica; idade so pela norma citada (codigo egipcio).

pares.citacao: sec.2.2.1 p.10: 'Over its service life, 30 Mpa cement concrete reabsorbs 3.65%, 4.47%, and 5.18% of carbon ... (Lee et al 2009)'
pares.nota: Notacao impressa: '30 Mpa'. Valor citado de Lee et al. 2009, sem idade. KS F 4009:2022 so e citada para o tempo de transporte do betao pronto (sec.2.2.3), nao para a classe. Tab.7 refere 'Ready-mix concrete 25-50' (base LCI coreana).

pares.citacao: p.12 'Anatomy of a T-Wall': 'must meet a minimum compressive strength of 20 MPa, commonly referred to as M20 grade concrete. M20 is composed of a specific mix ... Section 03300 ... US Department of State Bureau of Overseas Buildings Operations (USDoD 2006)'
pares.nota: Notacao impressa: 'M20' (notacao do IS 456, mas a norma indiana nao e citada); a especificacao citada e a Section 03300 do USDoD/OBO, sem idade no texto.

pares.citacao: sec.3.1 p.6: 'the concrete grades range from C30 to C60' + 'The structural design of the building is based on relevant codes including [54,55]' ([55] = GB 50010-2010 Code for Design of Concrete Structures); Tab.2 p.7 'C25 concrete'
